Reuse the device once in the night band, where a second approved frame is revealed through the finished deck silhouette as the 'built' result.

Recompose the hero as one title-block plate: h1 with city, lead and actions in one left column, and the slope-section deck rising into the empty upper right so it stands on the grade beside the headline, captioned '4:00 PM · bare slope'.
